change: The man is crouched at a dry white toilet bowl with his index finger held a few inches from the porcelain, pointing at one spot on the inside wall while he looks at another. Three different marks are visible around the bowl: a dark band, a pale chalky patch and a faint orange streak. Small bathroom, tiled floor, overhead light.
motion: he moves his pointing finger from the dark band across to the pale chalky patch and stops there

change: The man is kneeling on the bathroom floor with the cabinet doors under the sink wide open and half a dozen plain plastic bottles lined up on the tiles beside his knee, reaching in for another one. The shelf inside is nearly empty now. Even indoor light.
motion: he pulls one more bottle out of the cabinet and sets it down at the end of the row on the floor
causality: the row on the floor grows by exactly the one bottle he sets down and nothing else moves

change: The man is standing in a stranger's bathroom with one open hand held out flat toward the toilet, mid explanation, his eyebrows up as if stating something obvious. A toolbag sits by the door. Daylight from a frosted window.
motion: he turns his open hand over palm up and lets it drop slightly while he keeps talking

change: Close view of the man's wrist held up in front of his chest with a plain metal watch on it, his other hand resting on the closed toilet tank lid behind. Small bathroom, white tile, daylight from the left.
motion: he turns his wrist a little further to see the watch face and then lowers his arm

change: Close view of the man's hands, one thumb with a small shallow cut on the pad and the other hand peeling open a plain fabric bandage. Plain kitchen counter below, even indoor light.
motion: he pulls the paper tab off the bandage and brings it toward the cut thumb
causality: the paper backing comes away only where his fingers pull it and stays attached to the rest

change: Close view of the man's fingers pressing a white cotton ball against the pad of his thumb, with a small brown glass bottle standing on the counter beside his hand. Even indoor light, plain counter.
motion: he presses the cotton ball down on his thumb and rolls it slightly to one side

change: Close view of the man's hands twisting the white cap off a small brown glass bottle over a bathroom counter, the cap turning between his fingers. His face is at the top of the frame looking down. White tile behind, daylight from the left.
motion: he keeps turning the cap until it comes free and lifts it off the neck of the bottle
causality: the cap rises off the bottle only after it has finished unscrewing and the bottle stays upright

change: Close view of the man squeezing a plain glass dropper over a white saucer, one drop hanging off the tip. A small brown glass bottle stands behind on the counter. Even indoor light.
motion: the hanging drop falls from the dropper tip onto the saucer and he squeezes out a second one
causality: a drop leaves the dropper only when he squeezes and lands directly below on the saucer

change: Very close view of a white saucer with a grey-brown smear across it, half of the smear covered in a rising crust of fine white foam and the other half still flat and dull. Even indoor light from above.
motion: the foam creeps a little further across the smear and small bubbles keep breaking on the surface
causality: the foam grows only along the edge where it already is and never appears on the clean part of the saucer

change: Very close view of fine white bubbles rising and breaking on a wet porcelain surface, filling the frame, with the dark band of a stain visible underneath them. Even indoor light.
motion: bubbles keep rising and popping and the foam layer slowly thickens in place

change: The man is standing at a bathroom sink rinsing both hands under a running tap, looking down at them. A small brown glass bottle stands on the counter to one side. White tile, daylight from the left.
motion: he turns his hands over under the running water and rubs one thumb across the other palm

change: The man is standing in a small bathroom in the early morning in an old t-shirt, one hand flat on the counter, looking toward the toilet across the room with a neutral face. Cool daylight coming in low through a small window. White tile.
motion: he shifts his weight onto the hand on the counter and turns his head a little further toward the toilet

change: Close view of two plain drinking glasses of clear liquid standing side by side on a bathroom counter, the left one perfectly still and the right one full of fine rising bubbles. The man's hand is just leaving the frame beside them. White tile behind, daylight from the left.
motion: the bubbles keep rising in the right glass and the left glass stays completely still
causality: neither glass moves and the liquid level in both stays exactly the same

change: Close view of the man holding a plain metal teaspoon level over a bathroom counter, a small pile of white foam mounded up on the bowl of the spoon. A brown glass bottle stands behind. Even indoor light.
motion: he tilts the spoon slowly and the mound of foam slides toward the edge of it
causality: the foam keeps its shape as it slides and the spoon stays in his fingers the whole time

change: The man is reaching up to a bathroom shelf and taking down a small brown glass bottle from between a row of plain white bottles, looking at what he is doing. White tile wall behind the shelf, daylight from the left.
motion: he closes his fingers around the brown bottle and draws it straight out of the row
causality: only the brown bottle leaves the shelf and the bottles on either side stay standing where they are

change: Very close view of the man pressing the pad of his thumb against a dark band on dry white porcelain and lifting it away, a faint smear left on the thumb. Even indoor light from above.
motion: he presses his thumb on the band, holds it, and lifts it away to look at the underside of the thumb

change: The man is standing on the bathroom floor holding a small work light up beside his head, shining it down toward the toilet bowl, his face lit from the side. Small bathroom, tiled floor, the rest of the room dim.
motion: he lowers the work light slowly toward the bowl and leans his head after it

change: Very close view of the inside wall of a dry white toilet bowl, filling the frame, with a wide grey-brown band running across it and a faint slick sheen on the band. Even indoor light from above.
motion: a bead of clear liquid runs slowly down across the band and leaves a clean streak behind it
causality: the streak appears only along the path the bead has already travelled

change: Close view up under the rim of a white toilet, the row of small round holes on the underside filling the frame, dark and damp, with a thin dark line running along the channel behind them. Light coming in from below.
motion: a drop swells at the mouth of one of the holes and falls away

change: Close view down the inside wall of an empty white toilet tank, the porcelain streaked with a dark film and a dried water line partway up. A black rubber flapper sits at the bottom of the frame. Even indoor light from above.
motion: the man's gloved fingertip enters from the top of the frame and drags down the wall leaving a clean stripe
causality: the wall lightens only along the line his fingertip has already passed over

change: Close view of the brass chain and the black rubber flapper at the bottom of an empty toilet tank, the chain slack and hooked to the arm above. Even indoor light.
motion: the chain draws tight and the flapper lifts a couple of centimetres off its seat and settles back down
causality: the flapper only rises while the chain is tight and it seats back into the same opening

change: Very close view of a hard white chalky ridge standing out from the inside wall of a dry white toilet bowl, crusty and uneven, filling the frame. The porcelain above and below it is clean. Even indoor light.
motion: a trickle of clear liquid runs down over the chalky ridge and nothing at all happens to it
causality: the ridge stays exactly the same shape and colour as the liquid passes over it

change: The man is standing over a dry toilet bowl pouring from a plain clear plastic jug of white vinegar onto a pale chalky ridge at the waterline. His other hand rests on the rim. Small bathroom, white tile.
motion: he tips the jug further and moves it along the ridge so the stream keeps landing on the chalky part
causality: liquid lands only where the mouth of the jug is pointed and runs down from there

change: Close view of the man's hands holding a plain unlabelled squeeze bottle over a bathroom counter with a clear plastic jug of vinegar standing beside it, turning the squeeze bottle to look at the back of it. White counter, even indoor light, no text
motion: he turns the squeeze bottle around in his fingers and sets it down next to the jug

change: Very close view of a rust orange streak running down white porcelain, filling the frame, granular and uneven at the edges. Even indoor light from above.
motion: a thin trickle of clear liquid crosses the orange streak and runs past it without changing it
causality: the orange stays exactly where it is and only the clear trickle moves

change: Close view straight down at the still water inside an open toilet tank, an oily rainbow sheen spread across the surface and the dark shapes of the tank fittings under it. Even indoor light from above.
motion: the sheen drifts slowly across the surface and the reflection bends with it

change: The man is kneeling on the bathroom floor beside a plain plastic bucket, shaking a yellow rubber glove out over it, dark slime dropping off his fingers into the bucket. The open toilet tank is behind him. Tiled floor, overhead light.
motion: he shakes his gloved hand once and a lump of dark slime drops off into the bucket
causality: the slime leaves the glove only where he shakes it and falls straight down into the bucket

change: The man is standing over a toilet looking down into a bowl that is far too full, the water high and still, his hand still on the flush lever and his mouth set flat. Small bathroom, tiled floor, overhead light.
motion: he presses the flush lever again and watches the high water not move

change: The man is crouched beside the toilet wiping his hands on an old towel, the open tank behind him with the lid off, a yellow glove lying on the floor beside his knee. Tiled floor, overhead light.
motion: he works the towel between his fingers and then drapes it over his forearm

change: Close view of a bathroom sink with the tap running and the water in the basin faintly tinted rusty orange, a dark ring already on the porcelain around the drain. The man's hand rests on the edge of the basin. Even indoor light.
motion: the running water keeps swirling around the drain and the tint stays in the basin

change: The man is standing over a toilet lowering the heavy white porcelain tank lid back down onto the tank with both hands, looking at the edges to line it up. Small bathroom, white tile, daylight from the left.
motion: he lowers the lid the last few centimetres until it sits down flat on the tank
causality: the lid stays level in both hands and comes to rest squarely on the rim of the tank

change: Close view down into an open toilet tank with the light behind the man's shoulder, most of the inside in shadow, the water surface dark and flat and the plastic overflow tube standing up out of it. Small bathroom.
motion: a shadow moves slowly across the dark water as he leans over the opening

change: Close view of the man's hand tipping a plain plastic tub so that four round blue cleaning tablets slide toward the opening, held over a bathroom counter. White counter, even indoor light.
motion: he tips the tub a little further and the blue tablets slide down against the rim of the opening
causality: the tablets move only as far as he tips the tub and none leave it

change: Close view of the tall plastic fill valve inside an empty toilet tank, the float arm and the cap on top of it filling the frame, with a dark film on the plastic near the base. Even indoor light from above.
motion: the man's fingers enter from the side and lift the float arm a few centimetres, then let it back down
causality: only the float arm moves and the body of the valve stays fixed in the tank

change: Close view of the man's open palm holding a small grey rubber diaphragm and a plastic valve cap, tilted toward the light so the cracked edge of the rubber shows. Plain wall behind his hand, even indoor light.
motion: he tilts his palm slowly so the rubber diaphragm slides and turns over
causality: the rubber keeps the same shape while it slides and stays on his palm

change: Close view of the man's fingers holding a thick black rubber seal ring up in front of a plain wall, one side of it swollen and misshapen. Even indoor light.
motion: he turns the rubber ring slowly between his fingers to show the swollen side

change: The man is standing in a dark bathroom doorway at night in a t-shirt, one hand on the frame, looking in at the toilet, the room lit only by a dim hallway light behind him. Tiled floor.
motion: he leans his head into the dark bathroom to listen and stays there

change: The man is crouched on a bathroom floor pulling a small adjustable wrench out of an open canvas toolbag, the toilet base behind the bag. Tiled floor, overhead light.
motion: he draws the wrench up out of the toolbag and turns it over in his hand

change: Close view of the man's hand fitting a small wrench onto a stained bolt head down inside an empty toilet tank, the porcelain discoloured around it. Even indoor light from above.
motion: he seats the wrench on the bolt head and turns it a quarter turn
causality: only the bolt head turns and the wrench stays engaged on it the whole time

change: The man is leaning right over an open toilet tank with his bare forearm down inside it up to the elbow, feeling along the bottom, his face turned away with a grimace. Small bathroom, white tile.
motion: he moves his arm slowly along the bottom of the tank and turns his face further away

change: Close view of a new black rubber flapper being lowered onto the round opening at the bottom of an empty toilet tank by the man's fingers, the brass chain hanging beside it. Even indoor light.
motion: he lowers the flapper the last centimetre until it sits down into the opening and takes his fingers away
causality: the flapper settles into the same round opening and stays there once his fingers leave

change: The man is holding a round blue tablet over the open water of a toilet tank between two fingers, arm extended, his mouth set flat and his head shaking slightly. Small bathroom, overhead light.
motion: he closes his fingers around the blue tablet and pulls his hand back away from the tank instead of dropping it
causality: the tablet stays between his fingers the whole time and never touches the water

change: The man is leaning right over an open toilet tank with his head down close to the inside wall, squinting at a small pale rectangular label stuck to the porcelain, one hand braced on the rim. Small bathroom, overhead light, no text
motion: he leans a few centimetres closer to the pale label and tilts his head to read it

change: Close view of the man's hand setting a plain drinking glass of perfectly clear still water down on a bathroom counter and letting go. White counter, white tile behind, daylight from the left.
motion: he sets the glass down and draws his fingers away, and the water inside settles flat
causality: the glass stays standing exactly where he set it once his hand leaves

change: The man is standing in a small bathroom holding a plain clear jug of white vinegar up at chest height in one hand, looking at it with a doubtful expression. White tile behind him.
motion: he lifts the vinegar jug slightly and turns it a little toward himself, still looking at it

change: Very close view of a patch of white foam on a dark band on dry porcelain, the foam thinning and going flat, most of the bubbles already gone. Even indoor light from above.
motion: the last bubbles break one by one and the foam settles into a thin wet film
causality: the foam only shrinks and never grows back

change: The man is standing over a toilet with the bowl full of clear water, pouring from a small brown glass bottle straight into the standing water, watching it disperse. Small bathroom, tiled floor.
motion: he pours a steady stream into the full bowl and the liquid clouds and vanishes into the water
causality: the clear liquid mixes away into the standing water as soon as it lands

change: The man is crouched at a dry empty toilet bowl running a steady stream from a small brown glass bottle right along a dark band at the old waterline, following the curve. Small bathroom, tiled floor, overhead light.
motion: he moves the bottle slowly along the curve of the band and the liquid sits on the band instead of running away
causality: the band darkens with liquid only where the stream has already passed

change: Close view of a white bristled toilet brush being worked hard against a thick dark band on dry porcelain, the bristles bent flat and flecks of dark material lifting off. The man's hand grips the handle above. Even indoor light.
motion: he scrubs the brush back and forth twice across the same short stretch of the band
causality: the band breaks up only where the bristles are actually pressing

change: The man is standing in a bathroom doorway with a small brown glass bottle in one hand and a toilet brush in the other, looking in at the toilet as if arriving to do the job again. Daylight from a window inside the room.
motion: he lifts the brush slightly in one hand and steps his weight forward toward the room

change: Close view of two small brown glass bottles standing side by side on a bathroom counter, one full and one nearly empty, the man's hand resting on the counter behind them. White counter, daylight from the left.
motion: he taps the counter once beside the two bottles with a fingertip and leaves his hand there

change: Close view of the man's hand gripping the handle of a white toilet brush held upright in front of a plain bathroom wall, the wet bristles at the top of the frame. Even indoor light.
motion: he turns the brush handle a half turn in his grip so the bristles rotate

change: Very close view of a gloved fingertip wiping across a slick dark film on white porcelain and leaving a clean stripe, the film rolling up at the edge of the stripe. Even indoor light.
motion: the fingertip drags across and the dark film rolls up into a small ridge ahead of it
causality: the porcelain is only clean where the finger has already passed and the ridge grows as it goes

change: Close view of the inside of a toilet bowl where half the dark band has been scrubbed away to clean white porcelain and the other half is still dark, the line between them sharp. A brush head rests at the bottom of the frame. Even indoor light.
motion: the brush head enters from below and pushes a little further into the dark half, moving the line across
causality: the line only moves where the bristles reach

change: The man is crouched at the toilet scrubbing inside the bowl with a long handled brush, his shoulder working, looking down into the bowl. Small bathroom, tiled floor, overhead light.
motion: he scrubs steadily with short strokes and shifts the brush a little around the bowl

change: The man is standing in a small bathroom holding a large plain white plastic jug out at arm's length away from his body, looking at it with a wary expression and shaking his head. White tile behind him, no text
motion: he pushes the white jug further out from his body and shakes his head once

change: Close view of the man pulling a yellow rubber glove off his hand by the cuff, the glove half inside out, over a bathroom counter. Even indoor light.
motion: he pulls the cuff and the glove peels off his fingers and turns inside out
causality: the glove comes off only as far as he pulls and stays in his other hand

change: The man is standing in a small bathroom with both hands open and slightly raised, shoulders up in a small honest shrug, talking toward the camera with a wry look. White tile behind him, daylight from the left.
motion: he lets both hands drop back down to his sides and keeps talking

change: The man is holding a white toilet brush down inside a flushing toilet bowl, rinsing it in the moving water, looking down at it. Small bathroom, tiled floor, overhead light.
motion: he swirls the brush once in the moving water and lifts it a little to let it drip

change: Close view down into a white toilet bowl that is completely clean, the porcelain bright and even with clear water at the bottom and no band anywhere. Even indoor light from above.
motion: the clear water at the bottom of the bowl settles and its reflection steadies

change: Close view of the man's hand tipping a squat gel cleaner bottle with an angled neck over the rim of a toilet bowl, thick blue gel running down the porcelain. Small bathroom, even indoor light, no text
motion: he squeezes the bottle and moves the angled neck along under the rim so the gel keeps laying down a line
causality: gel appears on the porcelain only under the neck of the bottle as it passes

change: The man is standing over a toilet with a white plastic bleach jug tipped over the bowl in one hand, but his other hand is raised flat in a stop gesture and he is looking straight at the camera with a serious face. Small bathroom, tiled floor, no text
motion: he brings the bleach jug back upright and holds his flat hand up a little higher
causality: nothing leaves the jug at any point and it stays upright once he rights it

change: The man is pushing a small bathroom window open outward with one hand, turning his face toward the fresh air, the toilet visible behind him in the room. White tile, daylight coming through the opening window.
motion: he pushes the window a little further open and turns his head toward the gap

change: Close view of the man's hands screwing the white cap firmly back onto a small brown glass bottle over a bathroom counter, then setting it down. White counter, daylight from the left.
motion: he turns the cap down tight and sets the bottle upright on the counter
causality: the cap only tightens onto the neck and the bottle stays upright once it is down

change: The man is crouched at the open cabinet under a bathroom sink placing a small brown glass bottle upright at the front of a tidy row of bottles on the shelf. Pipes visible behind the row. Even indoor light.
motion: he sets the brown bottle down at the front of the row and slides it back a little to line it up
causality: only the bottle he is touching moves and the rest of the row stays as it is

change: Close view of the man's hand drawing a small circle with a pen on one square of a plain paper wall calendar hanging by a nail. Painted wall behind, daylight from the side, no text
motion: the pen tip goes round the square once and lifts away
causality: the ink line appears only along the path the pen tip has already travelled

change: The man is crouched on the bathroom floor standing a white toilet brush back into its plain plastic holder beside the toilet base, one hand on the handle. Tiled floor, overhead light.
motion: he lowers the brush into the holder until it seats and lets go of the handle

change: The man is standing outside on grass beside a round green plastic lid set flush into the lawn, looking down at it with his hands on his hips. Ordinary daylight, a plain house wall in the background.
motion: he shifts his weight and turns his head to look along the lawn past the round lid

change: Close view of the man holding a small brown glass bottle up close to his face and turning it to look at the plain white label, one eye slightly narrowed. Bathroom wall behind, daylight from the left, no text
motion: he turns the bottle a little further around to see more of the label

change: The man is standing in front of a shelf stacked with rows of plain coloured cleaning bottles, arms folded, looking along the shelf with a flat unimpressed expression. Even overhead light, no text
motion: he unfolds one arm and gestures once along the row of bottles, then folds his arms again

change: Close view of the man's open palm held out flat with a single small brown glass bottle standing upright on it, a plain bathroom wall behind. Daylight from the left.
motion: he raises his open palm a little higher and the bottle stays standing upright on it
causality: the bottle stays upright and does not slide as the palm rises

change: The man is standing in the bathroom doorway with one hand on the light switch, looking back over his shoulder at the clean toilet before leaving. The room behind him is lit by one overhead bulb. Tiled floor.
motion: he turns his head back toward the toilet and holds his hand on the switch without pressing it
